test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: G started walking straight from a point X. He turned 5 times right during his journey. Finally, he is facing towards east. In which direction he started walking from X? (He took no left turn)
solution:
Given:

G started walking straight and turned **5 times right**.

Finally, he is facing **East**.

Now,

Each right turn = 90° clockwise.

5 right turns = 4 + 1 turns → (360° + 90°) = **same as 1 right turn**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/198f0b5162961228c1ea957cd53f69c3ac3725ffe44e0873f27ac328925a0aef.png] 

So, initial direction + 1 right turn = East

Hence, initial direction = **North** (since North → right turn → East).

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
